summary: This note is a short biographical entry on singer Michelle Branch, covering her birth date and place and her family background. It names her parents, David and Peggy Branch, describes their ancestry, and lists her siblings, an older half-brother and a younger sister.
one_line: Biographical note on singer Michelle Branch, born 1983 in Sedona, Arizona, with details of her family background.
key_facts: Michelle Branch was born on July 2, 1983, in Sedona, Arizona.
Michelle Branch was born to David Branch and Peggy Branch.
Michelle Branch's mother is of Dutch-Indonesian ("Indo") and French descent.
Michelle Branch has an older half-brother named David.
Michelle Branch has a younger sister named Nicole.
